verdict.rationale: AWS documents that its CLI implements functionality equivalent to the browser-based Management Console, and that services can be automated through scripts. CloudFormation/CDK and service APIs such as Cost Explorer extend programmatic control to provisioning and billing data. missing for 10: an explicit statement of full API-level (not just CLI) parity with the console, independent or hands-on corroboration that no console-only features exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: the AWS CLI enables you to start running commands that implement functionality equivalent to that provided by the browser-based AWS Management Console from the command prompt in your terminal program
you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts
You can use the Cost Explorer API to programmatically query your cost and usage data.
CloudFormation takes care of provisioning and configuring those resources for you.
